of ₹25,305.00 lakh
was the net effect of
increase of ₹4,500.00
lakh and surrender of
₹29,805.00 lakh.
Increase was attributed
to scholarships and
stipends and Grants-in
aid-Non-Salary unit.

₹3,275.05 lakh is
overstated by
₹5,573.78 lakh due to
clearance of OB
suspense related to
previous years.

saving of ₹2,298.73
lakh. Reasons for
surrender as well as
actual saving have not
been intimated (July
2024).
